image_description: Four baby bibs arranged in a two-by-two grid on a flat surface. The top-left bib is white with lace trim and embroidered sheep; the top-right is cream-colored with lace trim and an embroidered girl figure; the bottom-left is cream with a green turtle embroidery; the bottom-right is cream with a pink snail embroidery. All feature rounded neck openings and decorative scalloped edges.
